title: Supreme Court Upholds Telangana Government's Ownership of 550 Acres in Miyapur
case_name: Private claimants v. State of Telangana (Miyapur land, Survey Nos. 100 and 101, Hyderabad)
card_summary: A Supreme Court bench of Justices M.M. Sundresh and Satish Chandra Sharma dismissed appeals by private claimants and upheld the Andhra Pradesh High Court's 2003 judgment that about 550 acres of government land in Miyapur, Hyderabad belongs to the state. It declined to entertain claims based on an alleged auction purchase and a will, since these were raised for the first time before it.
card_tip: A land title claim not raised before the trial or appellate forum gets no fresh hearing at the Supreme Court. Place every document, including an alleged auction purchase or will, on record at the earliest stage.
verification_notes: Decision date (29 October 2026), bench, dismissal of appeals and the basis (claims raised for the first time at the Supreme Court) corroborated across Deccan Chronicle, Siasat and Telangana Today. Political reaction and valuation figures in the broader coverage are not part of the holding and are omitted from the summary.
